channel.title: K-Culture Explained
channel.description: Korean food, holidays and daily life, explained with context.

item.title: Korean Public Holidays in 2026: The Full List, Explained
item.description: All 14 Korean public holidays for 2026 with dates, the substitute days off, the two holidays new for 2026, and why some dates move every year.

item.title: What Is Seollal? Korean Lunar New Year Customs Explained
item.description: How Koreans celebrate Seollal, from the charye rite and the sebae bow to tteokguk, yunnori, and fortune customs, based on the National Folk Museum and KTO.

item.title: Kimchi Varieties Explained
item.description: An overview of common kimchi types beyond cabbage kimchi, plus the Kimjang tradition behind Korea's seasonal kimchi-making culture.

item.title: Korean Table Manners, What the Official Guides Actually Say
item.description: A rundown of real Korean dining etiquette, from chopstick placement to pouring drinks for elders, based on Korea.net's official explainer series.

item.title: What Chuseok Is: Korea's Harvest Holiday Explained
item.description: An explanation of Chuseok, Korea's autumn harvest holiday, covering its traditions, food, and how the holiday is marked across the country.

item.title: Why Korean Age Changed, the 2023 Law Explained
item.description: How South Korea's 2023 law standardized age counting to the international system, and what changed for the traditional "Korean age" most people had used.
